lineas.texto: The dam above the mine broke, and the water came through the tunnel like a train.
Most of the crew ran for the shaft. I was too deep.
I climbed into an old side gallery, higher than the rest. A pocket of air.
One headlamp. Half a bottle of water. And the water stopped one meter below my feet.
On the third day, I heard knocking. Three knocks, from under the water.
Rescue divers knock to find survivors. So I knocked back.
A light came on under the water. But it came from the deep end, a tunnel flooded for forty years.
